# Requirements

## REQ-001 View room availability

functional, must

The system shall let a user see which meeting rooms are free for a chosen date and time range.

Acceptance criteria:

- Given a date and time range, the system lists rooms with no booking overlapping that range as free
- Rooms with an overlapping booking are not shown as free

## REQ-002 Book a room

functional, must

The system shall let a user book a free room for a chosen time slot.

Acceptance criteria:

- A user can create a booking for a free room with a start and end time
- The new booking appears in the room's schedule and in the user's bookings

## REQ-003 No overlapping bookings

functional, must

The system shall reject any booking that overlaps in time with an existing booking for the same room.

Acceptance criteria:

- A booking whose time range overlaps an existing booking for the same room is rejected with an error message
- Two simultaneous requests for the same room and overlapping time result in only one stored booking
- Bookings in different rooms at the same time are allowed

## REQ-004 Cancel a booking

functional, must

The system shall let a user cancel their own bookings.

Acceptance criteria:

- A user can cancel a booking they created
- After cancellation the time slot is shown as free
- A user cannot cancel another user's booking

## REQ-005 Admin manages rooms

functional, must

The system shall let admins add, edit and remove meeting rooms.

Acceptance criteria:

- An admin can add a room and it becomes available for booking
- An admin can edit a room's details
- An admin can remove a room
- Non-admin users cannot perform these actions

## REQ-006 Browser-based

non-functional, must

The system shall be usable in a web browser without installing client software.

Acceptance criteria:

- All user and admin functions are accessible through a web browser

## Open questions

- Q-001: How do users sign in (e.g. company SSO, username/password, none), and how is someone designated an admin? (REQ-004, REQ-005)
- Q-002: What attributes does a room have (name, capacity, location, equipment)? (REQ-005, REQ-001)
- Q-003: Are there rules on time slots: fixed length or free start/end, minimum/maximum duration, bookable hours, how far ahead, and recurring bookings? (REQ-002, REQ-003)
- Q-004: What should happen to existing future bookings when an admin removes a room? (REQ-005)
- Q-005: Can admins cancel or edit any user's booking, and should users be able to change a booking rather than cancel and rebook? (REQ-004)
